card.name: Ending of alkaloid drug class names
card.fires_on: The final piece "oids" or "oid" completing the word alkaloid(s), as in vinca, veratrum, ergot or rauwolfia alkaloids, in drug interaction text. Weaker on "olic" inside mycophenolic.
